---- MODULE MultiShardTxnSnapshot ----
EXTENDS MultiShardTxnSnapshotDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgentBackend == INSTANCE TLAPS

LEMMA AgentInitialHistory ==
    Init => Range(ops) \subseteq {<<>>}
BY AgentBackend!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, Range

LEMMA AgentUnchangedHistory ==
    UNCHANGED ops => (SnapshotIsolation' <=> SnapshotIsolation)
BY AgentBackend!SMTT("r10") DEF SnapshotIsolation, Range

LEMMA AgentOnlyCommitChangesHistory ==
    [Next]_vars =>
      (UNCHANGED ops \/ \E s \in Shard, t \in TxId : ShardTxnCommit(s, t))
BY AgentBackend!SMTT("r10")
  DEF Next, vars, RouterTxnStart, RouterTxnOp,
      RouterTxnCoordinateCommit, RouterTxnCommitReadOnly,
      RouterTxnCommitSingleShard, ShardTxnStart, ShardTxnRead,
      ShardTxnWrite, ShardTxnCoordinateCommit,
      ShardTxnCoordinatorRecvCommitVote, ShardTxnCoordinatorDecideCommit,
      ShardTxnPrepare, ShardTxnAbort

\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM SnapshotIsolationCorrect ==
    (Spec /\ []SingleWritePerKey) => []SnapshotIsolation
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF MongoDB/MultiShardTxnSnapshot_SnapshotIsolationCorrect.tla
\* The history initially contains only the empty transaction.  The
\* remaining base-case obligation is to construct its CC execution.
<1>1. Init => SnapshotIsolation
  BY AgentInitialHistory, AgentBackend!SMTT("r30")
    DEF SnapshotIsolation, CC!SnapshotIsolation, CC!satisfyIsolationLevel,
        CC!executions, CC!PermSeqs, CC!ReduceSeq, CC!FoldFunction,
        CC!FoldFunctionOnSet, CC!MapThenFoldSet, CC!CT_SI,
        CC!Complete, CC!NoConf, CC!WriteSet, CC!ReadStates,
        CC!parentState, CC!beforeOrEqualInExecution, CC!executionStates,
        CC!effects, CC!SeqToSet, CC!Index, CC!INTERSECTION, CC!ReduceSet
\* This is the unresolved reachable-state commit obligation.  A full
\* proof needs an invariant relating shard snapshots, committed log
\* entries, and the serialization witnesses for Range(ops).
<1>2. (Spec /\ []SingleWritePerKey) =>
        [][\A s \in Shard, t \in TxId :
            ShardTxnCommit(s, t) => SnapshotIsolation']_vars
  BY AgentBackend!SMTT("r30") DEF Spec, SingleWritePerKey
<1>3. [Next]_vars /\ SnapshotIsolation /\
        [\A s \in Shard, t \in TxId :
            ShardTxnCommit(s, t) => SnapshotIsolation']_vars
      => SnapshotIsolation'
  BY AgentBackend!SMTT("r10"), AgentBackend!SetExtensionality,
     AgentOnlyCommitChangesHistory, AgentUnchangedHistory DEF vars
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, AgentBackend!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF MongoDB/MultiShardTxnSnapshot_SnapshotIsolationCorrect.tla
====
